8c56fdbe2f6d0049.title: What does the Myanmar genocide ruling mean for the Rohingya?
8c56fdbe2f6d0049.summary: Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh cheered an International Court of Justice finding that Myanmar committed genocide.

9a626d0b39103af2.title: ‘On the same page’: Hegseth hails US ties with Colombia’s de la Espriella
9a626d0b39103af2.summary: The US defence secretary praised security cooperation with Colombia as country joins Americas Counter Cartel Coalition.

8de921d60327898d.title: Kushner says Russia ‘comfortable’ with NATO-like guarantees for Ukraine
8de921d60327898d.summary: European leaders meet in Berlin after Trump summit with Putin and Xi. Putin vows to retaliate for Kerch Bridge strikes.

f42ff282762eb62b.title: 'Humanitarian mission' for Kostiantynivka: Is it a trap?
f42ff282762eb62b.summary: Russian President Putin has proposed an evacuation of the Ukrainian city of Kostiantynivka, like the recent operation in Oleshky. Experts warn this could serve military, not humanitarian, aims. What should Kyiv do?

9fadaeea4137c47f.title: Uganda minister at COP31: 'We need a just transition'
9fadaeea4137c47f.summary: Funding from wealthy countries to help deal with the impacts of climate change hasn't materialized, says Uganda's environment minister. The East African country is hoping oil and carbon credits will help boost finances.

e9a1d64fadb5d95f.title: Germany news: Pistorius visits Auschwitz memorial in Poland trip
e9a1d64fadb5d95f.summary: Germany's defense minister's first stop in Poland was the memorial site of the former Nazi extermination camp Auschwitz-Birkenau. Follow DW for more.

decae37700caa0c7.title: Iraq's risky standoff: The state vs. Iran-allied militias
decae37700caa0c7.summary: This week, Iraqi security forces surrounded an area run by the Kataib Hezbollah militia. Onlookers describe it as the most dangerous confrontation between the Iraqi state and Iran-allied militias in decades.

ad130f59243d31ae.title: European leaders present united front in push for peace in Ukraine
ad130f59243d31ae.summary: Talks in Berlin end with reaffirmed support for Kyiv and a concerted push for European representation at future peace talks to end Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

72c040a76cc71caf.title: Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin have held trilateral talks ― but what did they achieve?
72c040a76cc71caf.summary: The presidents of China, the US and Russia have held an unprecedented summit. While Trump said the three leaders were "making history," Xi described the talks as "fruitful" and Putin called them "open and candid."

7f9ff0fd6c1d0b31.title: Ukraine-Russland-Verhandlungen: Wer spricht für Europa und wer nicht?
7f9ff0fd6c1d0b31.summary: Ein europäisches Verhandlungsteam soll bei künftigen Ukraine-Russland-Gesprächen mit am Tisch sitzen. Doch wie haltbar ist diese Übereinkunft von vergangener Woche und was sagt sie über den Zustand Europas?

08e98e8f80b6eb99.title: Koalition der Willigen in Berlin: "Wir halten zur Ukraine"
08e98e8f80b6eb99.summary: Die sogenannte Koalition der Willigen stärkt der Ukraine in Berlin den Rücken. Und alle blicken zum Treffen der USA, Russlands und China in Shenzhen. Von dort aus lädt Präsident Putin die Europäer nach Moskau ein.

faacbf0320d52a37.title: Wadephul im Südkaukasus: Frieden sichern - Putin fernhalten?
faacbf0320d52a37.summary: In Aserbaidschan und Armenien wirbt Bundesaußenminister Wadephul für die Unterzeichnung des Friedensvertrags zwischen den Nachbarn und lobt deren Annährung an den Westen. Für Russland hat er eine klare Botschaft.

8a3271186d8ccdeb.title: Major anti-gang offensive in Haiti kills 34 suspected gang members
8a3271186d8ccdeb.summary: Haitian security forces launched a major offensive on Thursday to retake Martissant, a strategic corridor linking Port-au-Prince with the country's western and southern regions that gangs have controlled for five years. Police said at least 34 suspected gang members were killed in clashes involving a private security task force.

ae13996eecacb172.title: Anthropic goes public after blockbuster IPO but fails to revive AI trade
ae13996eecacb172.summary: Anthropic has become the first pure-play AI developer to be publicly traded on the stock market, following a record-setting IPO. The stock opened 34% higher, briefly valuing the company at more than $2 trillion, before ending its first day of trading up 17%. However, Wall Street indexes closed sharply lower as investors took profits, reflecting underlying market jitters about the AI trade.

55f7ab39318c1582.title: French far-left candidate Mélenchon opens door to alliance with rival Greens candidate
55f7ab39318c1582.summary: French far-left leader Jean-Luc Mélenchon opened the door to an alliance with France's Greens on Thursday after their presidential candidate Marine Tondelier said she was ready to "work on a coalition around" the veteran leftist. Tondelier's overture has further boosted Mélenchon's campaign for the Élysée Palace – and angered moderates on the centre-left.

d5c33d2f04d15bc5.title: Kenyan marathon champion banned for doping
d5c33d2f04d15bc5.summary: In tonight's edition, Kenyan athletics superstar and reigning marathon world champion Peres Jepchirchir is banned for three years for doping. Also, South African judges leave the courtroom behind and tour a repatriation centre before handing down judgment in 33 emergency asylum applications. And Ghana's presidency has a new jet, but critics of the ruling party are not on board.

ad042c07c0644c27.title: Russian strikes on Kyiv kill one, damage Dutch and Austrian embassies
ad042c07c0644c27.summary: A wave of daytime Russian strikes on Kyiv on Thursday killed one person and damaged a historic cathedral as well as the embassies of Austria and the Netherlands. Loud explosions erupted across the Ukraine capital throughout the day as the leaders of Russia, China and the United States held a historic meeting in China that put Russia's President Vladimir Putin in international spotlight. FRANCE 24's Laurent Berstecher reports.

4f79f661274647d4.title: 'We're seeing in real time the effects that AI is going to have on cybersecurity', expert says
4f79f661274647d4.summary: FRANCE 24's Monte Francis speaks with Dr. R. David Edelman, Senior Fellow at the Brookings Institution, also former Director for Cybersecurity on the National Security Council under the Obama administration. He explains that the latest spate of network outages shows "in real time the effects that AI is going to have on cybersecurity" adding that "the one thing that's tying most of these outages together is that companies and institutions are racing to patch a system that's been identified as vulnerable, and they're patching what themselves are pretty creaky digital systems".

dbb52d80e202a311.title: Kushner says Trump 'open' to extend NATO mutual defense-type clause to Ukraine
dbb52d80e202a311.summary: US envoy Jared Kushner said Thursday that President Donald Trump was open to extending to Ukraine a security guarantee similar to NATO's mutual defense clause, but stressed that Washington has to protect its interests too. The comments came as German Chancellor Friedrich Merz qualified the summit between the presidents of the United States, Russia and China as a "photo op". FRANCE 24's international affairs commentator Douglas Herbert explains.

28e83fda17be3417.title: Macron urges Ukraine's allies to 'reopen the question' of NATO membership
28e83fda17be3417.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron on Thursday called for Ukraine's allies to speed up the delivery of urgently needed air defence systems and urged them to "reopen the question" of Ukraine's NATO membership after talks in Berlin aimed at reaffirming European support for Kyiv.

1849409bc4178585.title: A president among body bags: Photo ops spark outrage in Colombia
1849409bc4178585.summary: Since taking office in August, Colombia's far-right President Abelardo de la Espriella has regularly posted videos that show him walking among body bags supposedly holding the remains of rebel fighters – a communications strategy that has sparked widespread criticism.

ff14204cea599f55.title: Three of a kind? Xi hosts Trump and Putin as Ukraine war grinds on
ff14204cea599f55.summary: Gang of three or glorified photo op? Xi Jinping hosting Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the APEC summit. Already, our Monday panel rejected attempts to paint the three-way meeting as a new Yalta, as in the 1945 sit-down on the Black Sea that defined the post-war security architecture of Europe.

b0605d660b9a2170.title: Xi-Trump-Putin trilateral meeting: Trump's recognition of China and Russia as 'peers of the US'
b0605d660b9a2170.summary: Genie Godula is pleased to welcome Olivia Cheung. The trilateral meeting between Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin at the APEC summit was significant despite the absence of concrete agreements, according to Cheung. “The significance is seen in the precedence of the United States seeing and giving recognition that China and Russia are peers of the United States,” she explained, adding that “the image of a G3 is very significant.”

944d294598da9d6c.title: NASA's Voyager 1 phones home from record one light-day away, 49 years after launch
944d294598da9d6c.summary: The Voyager 1 probe launched by NASA nearly a half century ago has reached a distance from Earth of one light day (more than 26 billion kilometres), the farthest any human artifact has ever ventured from our planet. The space agency received a signal from the spacecraft Thursday, exactly 24 hours after it was sent.

37f19376eaa9a8aa.title: French media regulator says it will monitor top YouTubers for bias in election coverage
37f19376eaa9a8aa.summary: Rules designed to safeguard media pluralism during elections campaigns will apply to France's most influential YouTubers in the run-up to next year's presidential contest, media regulator Arcom warned on Thursday, reflecting the growing influence of content creators whose audiences often outstrip those of traditional media companies.

01bbae4aed66e39f.title: What impact will the Shenzhen summit have on the US-China trade war?
01bbae4aed66e39f.summary: Despite warm words between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping at three-way talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen Thursday, the simmering trade war between Washington and Beijing still looks to be no closer to resolution.

15064a2cc8b43adf.title: Bangladesh: Hasina supporters vandalise ruling party office
15064a2cc8b43adf.summary: Hundreds of supporters of ousted Bangladesh premier Sheikh Hasina staged street protests on Thursday, as a wave of arson attacks escalated tensions ahead of her planned return from exile next month.

82f352b935b7e493.title: Yannick Jadot quitte les Écologistes après la main tendue de Marine Tondelier à Jean-Luc Mélenchon
82f352b935b7e493.summary: Les fractures deviennent apparentes chez les Écologistes, au lendemain de la main tendue de Marine Tondelier à Jean-Luc Mélenchon : Yannick Jadot, sénateur et ex-candidat écologiste à la présidentielle, a annoncé qu'il quittait le parti, tout comme le député Jérémie Iordanoff. Tous les deux préfèrent soutenir Raphaël Glucksmann.

3044856312fdbab2.title: Montée de l'extrême droite en France : "Les Allemands ont un regard extrêmement inquiet"
3044856312fdbab2.summary: La progression de l’extrême droite en France et en Allemagne répond "à des logiques similaires", explique Hélène Miard-Delacroix, germaniste et historienne française. Retrouvez l'émission dans son intégralité ce samedi midi sur la chaîne YouTube de France 24.

fdf4dcf015444292.title: La police d'Haïti dit avoir tué 34 membres de gang à Port-au-Prince
fdf4dcf015444292.summary: Jeudi, une opération visant "une base du chef de gang Ti Lapli" à Port-au-Prince a permis de neutraliser 34 membres, a annoncé la police d'Haïti, alors que la capitale est depuis peu le théâtre d'un déploiement d'envergure de l'armée salvadorienne contre les bandes armées locales.

e13513e545307bbc.title: Primaire de la droite et du centre, Marine Tondelier tend la main à LFI
e13513e545307bbc.summary: La primaire de la droite et du centre aura-t-elle lieu ? Et quel en sera le périmètre ? La première réunion a eu lieu avec les équipes de Gabriel Attal, Bruno Retailleau et David Lisnard mais sans Edouard Philippe qui continue à la refuser. A gauche, Marine Tondelier, la patronne des Verts, fait un pas vers Jean-Luc Mélenchon pour la présidentielle et divise son parti.

f33affa51d51b22a.title: Procès du canal "Femmeblancherie" : de la prison ferme requise contre des masculinistes
f33affa51d51b22a.summary: Jusqu'à deux ans de prison ferme ont été requis, jeudi à Paris, contre le fondateur du groupe Telegram "femmeblancherie" et six autres hommes, jugés pour des propos haineux visant notamment les femmes, dans le premier procès de la mouvance masculiniste en France.

4cf416a3db1143f9.title: COP31 sur le climat : les énergies fossiles retirées du projet de décision finale
4cf416a3db1143f9.summary: Les énergies fossiles ne figurent plus dans le nouveau projet de décision finale de la COP31 sur le climat publié jeudi à Antalya (Turquie), un recul dénoncé avec force par les ONG à la veille de la fin théorique des négociations.

32db1864f68e754a.title: Xi, Trump, Poutine : un Yalta 2.0 ?
32db1864f68e754a.summary: C’est peut-être l'image de l’année : Xi Jinping, Donald Trump et Vladimir Poutine réunis à Shenzhen en Chine. C’est la première fois que les présidents de ces trois puissances se rencontraient. Ils ont adopté une "déclaration de paix" et se sont engagés en faveur de la "stabilité stratégique". Au même moment, les Européens étaient réunis à Berlin : les pays de la coalition des volontaires ont discuté de l’intensification du soutien à l’Ukraine. Cette rencontre est-elle un Yalta 2.0 ? Quelle place pour les Européens ?

216de5563653b26b.title: Corée du Sud : un examen crucial en plein scandale de triche à l’IA
216de5563653b26b.summary: Les ​élèves sud-coréens ont passé jeudi 19 novembre le Suneung, le rigoureux examen national d'entrée à l'université, dans une ambiance tendue après un scandale de triche ​lié à l'intelligence artificielle il y a deux semaines.

c0abf4458d94954e.title: "GTA VI" : prouesses techniques, budget, ventes... le jeu vidéo de tous les records
c0abf4458d94954e.summary: Treize ans d'attente, un budget estimé à plus d'un milliard de dollars et des ventes déjà vertigineuses… "GTA VI" affole tous les compteurs. Mais ce nouvel épisode du célèbre jeu vidéo est-il à la hauteur des attentes ? Les premiers joueurs saluent le réalisme du jeu, la narration digne d'un film hollywoodien et le foisonnement de détails.

7d52a8502a682a58.title: Macron demande aux alliés de l'Ukraine de "rouvrir la question de son adhésion à l'Otan"
7d52a8502a682a58.summary: Appelant les alliés de Kiev réunis à Berlin, dont les États-Unis, à faire le "maximum" pour lui livrer "maintenant" les moyens de défense antiaériens dont elle a besoin, le président français a demandé jeudi à "rouvrir la question de l'adhésion de l'Ukraine à l'Otan".

d19dd217470623f9.title: Anthropic fait son entréé en bourse
d19dd217470623f9.summary: Anthropic signe une entrée en Bourse historique. Le créateur de l’IA Claude a levé plus de 81 milliards de dollars, malgré les turbulences du secteur. Que révèle ce succès sur les attentes des investisseurs ? Cette opération ouvre-t-elle la voie à une future introduction en Bourse d’OpenAI ? Guillaume Grallet, rédacteur en chef tech et sciences au Point et chroniqueur à France 24, auteur de Pionniers, voyage aux frontières de l’intelligence artificielle, décrypte cette opération.

5dbc2f0430874825.title: COP31: l'avenir de l'agriculture en question
5dbc2f0430874825.summary: Le réchauffement climatique est l'un des principaux facteurs d'aggravation de l'insécurité alimentaire dans le monde. L'agriculture mondiale est victime de ce phénomène mais l'aggrave aussi puisqu'elle est responsable de près d'un quart des émissions mondiales de gaz à effet de serre et contribue à affaiblir le puit carbone des sols. Pour la FAO transformer l'agriculture pour qu'elle soit moins émettrice et garantisse la sécurité alimentaire mondiale doit être la priorité des priorités.

84f9c47d88a12f21.title: Au procès Zecler, prison ferme requise contre les policiers, qui se défendent de tout racisme
84f9c47d88a12f21.summary: L'accusation a requis jeudi entre quatre et six ans de prison ferme contre les trois policiers ayant passé à tabac le producteur de musique noir Michel Zecler en 2020. La défense reconnait des "violences inadmissibles" mais conteste la lourdeur des peines requises et rejette toute dimension raciste.

540062ae495bc547.title: Présidentielle : les créateurs de contenus sommés de respecter le pluralisme par l'Arcom
540062ae495bc547.summary: Créateurs de contenus et influenceurs devront pour la première fois respecter les règles du pluralisme pendant la campagne de la présidentielle 2027, au même titre que la radio et la télévision, a annoncé jeudi le régulateur de l'audiovisuel et du numérique. En cas de manquements répétés, l'Arcom pourra décider de sanctions financières.

1ae8dd2f3a0635e7.title: JOJ Dakar 2026 : à la rencontre de Nalorie Joelle, maquilleuse dans les coulisses
1ae8dd2f3a0635e7.summary: Des études en sciences politiques aux coulisses des JOJ Dakar 2026 : Nalorie Joelle trace son chemin dans le maquillage artistique. Retour sur le parcours d'une jeune Sénégalaise qui a contribué à la magie de la cérémonie d'ouverture. Un reportage d'Alexandrine Holognon

0ec934c8968d31b0.title: قمة شنجن الثلاثية: بوتين يعود إلى واجهة المشهد الدولي إلى جانب ترامب وشي رغم العقوبات الغربية
0ec934c8968d31b0.summary: شكّلت قمة شنجن في الصين عودة بارزة للرئيس الروسي فلاديمير بوتين إلى واجهة المشهد الدولي، بعدما تصدّر المشهد إلى جانب نظيريه الأمريكي دونالد ترامب والصيني شي جينبينغ. واعتُبر اللقاء الثلاثي مكسبا دبلوماسيا لبوتين، في ظل استمرار الحرب في أوكرانيا والعقوبات الغربية المفروضة على موسكو.

e318738d798f2fcd.title: أنثروبيك: الذكاء الاصطناعي يدخل البورصة
e318738d798f2fcd.summary: في حدث اليوم نسلط الضوء على دخول شركة أنثروبيك إلى البورصة حيث سجلت أسهم الشركة الأمريكية، المطورة لنموذج الذكاء الاصطناعي "كلود"، ارتفاعا تجاوز 34% في أول أيام تداولها ببورصة وول ستريت لترتفع قيمتها السوقية إلى نحو تريليوني دولار. ضيف حدث اليوم: شريف عثمان، مؤسس ورئيس شركة بويز للاستثمارات.

557629dd198fcedd.title: هايتي: السلفادور تعلن تدمير منزل زعيم عصابة مسلحة
557629dd198fcedd.summary: في ثاني عملية من نوعها تستهدف جماعات إجرامية تسيطر على جزء كبير من هايتي أعلنت السلفادور تدمير منزل أحد زعماء العصابات. الرئيس السلفادوري قال إن المنزل يعود إلى أحد قادة تحالف عصابات مدجج بالسلاح يُعرف باسم "فيف أنسانم". رئيس السلفادور نجيب بوكيلة كان قد أرسل أكثر من 2000 جندي إلى هايتي منذ أواخر أكتوبر، وجاءت هذه العملية في الأساس بحثا عن أربعة جنود سلفادوريين مدعومين من الأمم المتحدة فُقدوا في هايتي.

276f161ea5d1b846.title: شنجن: قمة ثلاثية لتقاسم النفوذ في العالم؟
276f161ea5d1b846.summary: في هذه الحلقة من النقاش نتطرق إلى مخرجات القمة الثلاثية بين شي جينبينغ وترامب وبوتين والتي احتضنتها مدينة شينجن الصينية، قمة عقدت تحت مظلة بحث السلام العالمي وتمخض عنها إعلان يلتزم بموجبه القادة الثلاث بالحفاظ على الاستقرار والأمن العالميين والدفع نحو إصلاح الأمم المتحدة والحد من انتشار الأسلحة النووية. ضيوف النقاش: رامي الخليفة العلي، كاتب سياسي. بسام طيارة، باحث في العلوم السياسية مختص بالشؤون الاسيوية. هلال العبيدي، كاتب ومحلل سياسي.

17303e28e07de5ee.title: المفوضية الأوروبية تؤكد تعرضها لهجوم إلكتروني باستخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي وتفتح تحقيقا
17303e28e07de5ee.summary: كشفت المفوضية الأوروبية الخميس عن تعرض أنظمتها لهجوم إلكتروني باستخدام أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي، رُصد في 22 أكتوبر/تشرين الأول، ما دفعها إلى تعطيل عدد من تطبيقاتها مؤقتا. وأكدت أن التحقيقات لا تزال جارية لتحديد حجم الهجوم، مشيرة إلى عدم وجود أدلة على تسرب بيانات موظفيها.

fd069bf905918f87.title: ما الذي يمكن استخلاصه من القمة غير المسبوقة بين ترامب وشي ويوتين؟
fd069bf905918f87.summary: اختتمت، الخميس، أعمال القمة الثلاثية غير المسبوقة بين الرؤساء الصيني والأمريكي والروسي في مدينة شنجن الصينية. وجاء في "إعلان السلام" الذي صدر عقب القمة، وبحسب ما نشر الكرملين والإعلام الرسمي الصيني، أن الرؤساء الثلاثة "أكدوا التزامهم بالحفاظ على الاستقرار الاستراتيجي والأمن الدولي". وأكد بوتين خلال القمة وجود "مصلحة مشتركة" للدول الثلاث في تسوية الحرب في أوكرانيا.

b5b5389eec49d4c3.title: Myanmar Committed Genocide Against the Rohingya, Top Global Court Finds
b5b5389eec49d4c3.summary: In a decision with potentially broad implications, the International Court of Justice found a state culpable of genocide for the first time.

e4654b3ad6faa5d0.summary: The Russian leader invited European representatives to Moscow to discuss giving them a role in negotiations. It was unclear how serious the offer was.

5609de10c6585f78.title: Myanmar Genocide Ruling Sets Up Court Fight Over Israel and Gaza
5609de10c6585f78.summary: The ruling by the International Court of Justice deals with issues relevant to the case brought against Israel alleging genocide in Gaza. Israel has rejected the charge.

f88a3502ca31e7aa.title: Dutch and Austrian Embassies Are Damaged as Russian Drones Swarm Kyiv
f88a3502ca31e7aa.summary: Foreign ministers for Austria and the Netherlands said no one was harmed at their embassy compounds, and the European Union’s ambassador said a drone “exploded right above my head" by her hotel.

00e1e1f1ea025ef4.title: Unexpected Fallout From the Iran War
00e1e1f1ea025ef4.summary: Global oil shocks are accelerating the shift to electric vehicles and renewable energy, a new report finds.

1566a3b9fd2e1330.title: Love and Carjackings in a Video Game
1566a3b9fd2e1330.summary: Grand Theft Auto once caused a moral panic. Now, it’s a “signature cultural event.”

192dc28e1e9cb828.title: Nvidia Asked to Sell Chips to Companies Tied to Chinese Military and Megaspeed
192dc28e1e9cb828.summary: Lawmakers released confidential information showing the Commerce Department had approved sales of more than 800,000 A.I. chips to Chinese companies, some with military ties.

2b8291cfea2ff264.title: Judge Allows Trump’s $15 Billion Case Against The Times to Proceed
2b8291cfea2ff264.summary: Mr. Trump accused the news organization and the book publisher Penguin Random House of disparaging his reputation as a successful businessman.

bde5d897ccc86ea5.title: Anthropic’s I.P.O. Turns Tech Researchers Into Overnight Millionaires
bde5d897ccc86ea5.summary: Many people who joined the A.I. company a few years ago might have had little reason to think how big Anthropic would become. They are now worth tens of millions of dollars, if not more.

ae3cb2e1033c4fb0.title: This Billionaire Just Made a Bundle Off A.I. But It Could Have Been More.
ae3cb2e1033c4fb0.summary: Gregory Jensen, a hedge-fund billionaire, invested early in Anthropic and OpenAI. But to fund a succession plan at his firm, he told colleagues that he sold his OpenAI stake.

4c6687f112878646.title: What You Should Know About Downdetector Before the Next Big Tech Outage
4c6687f112878646.summary: The website has been checked and cited often during an unusually busy week of technology problems, though its operators acknowledge its limitations.

eebaee7243a8071a.title: How Much Anthropic Are You About to Own?
eebaee7243a8071a.summary: See how much of the stock you may own through common index funds, like those found in retirement accounts.

094b496384da73c8.title: JPMorgan Chase Customer Data Is Exposed in Latest Hack
094b496384da73c8.summary: The bank, which earlier this week suffered a brief technology outage, said no sensitive information was taken in an incident that also affected Mastercard and Visa.

3396ff170854daed.title: With GTA 6 Release, DoorDash and Other Food Delivery Apps Are Making a Killing
3396ff170854daed.summary: The gamers staying home in droves have to be fed, and the meal business was more than ready to feed them.

978f89b957959b2c.summary: On November 19, the International Court of Justice delivered a historic ruling: finding Myanmar guilty of committing genocide against the Rohingya in 2017. Malaysia has long been a supporter of the persecuted Muslim minority. But its role as a safe haven is coming to an end, amid a rise in hate speech and calls for the expulsion of Rohingya via social media.

3672f6e814fffad7.title: Italy strike draws workers, students into nationwide protests over wages and living costs
3672f6e814fffad7.summary: A nationwide strike was expected to disrupt schools, hospitals and local transport across Italy on Friday as workers and students began marching in dozens of cities to demand higher wages, lower living costs and greater social protections. The labor action coincided with an International Day of Student Mobilisation, with organisers planning demonstrations in more than 45 Italian cities. FRANCE 24's Seema Gupta reports from Rome, Italy.

2d191bf5d84a5610.title: South Africa: High Court examines asylum seekers' detention at Lindela centre
2d191bf5d84a5610.summary: South Africa's High Court judges visited the Lindela Repatriation Centre in Krugersdorp this week, ahead of delivering a ruling on 33 urgent applications concerning the detention of asylum seekers. The court is examining conflicting interpretations of a Constitutional Court ruling that prohibits the deportation of asylum seekers whose claims are still being processed. The case comes amid a wider and increasingly tense debate over immigration in South Africa, which has at times spilled over into deadly xenophobic violence. FRANCE 24's Eunice Masson reports from Cape Town, South Africa.

813f0a1b8115806e.title: 'Our culture and identity': Deaf Nigerians embrace indigenous sign languages
813f0a1b8115806e.summary: With a quick flick of the wrist, Umaru Zayyanu conveys the phrase "I am a Nigerian". But the 37-year-old is not signing, rather in the west African nation's official sign language. Instead, he's using Hausa sign language. Such indigenous sign languages abound in Africa's most populous country, where deaf people were communicating with each other long before the advent of formal sign language taught in deaf schools, in 1960.

0326300e59a757d5.title: Ghana's $60 million presidential jet purchase sparks controversy
0326300e59a757d5.summary: Ghanaian President John Mahama is facing growing criticism over his government's recent purchase of a $60 million presidential jet. While in opposition, Mahama had criticised similar plans by the previous administration. The government in Accra is now defending the purchase, pointing to the country's improved economic situation. It argues that the question was never whether the ageing presidential aircraft should be replaced, but rather when the timing would be right. FRANCE 24's Justice Baidoo reports.

4c25fcd6d18345ef.title: France awaits verdict in landmark police brutality trial over Michel Zecler assault
4c25fcd6d18345ef.summary: A French prosecutor on Thursday urged a court to jail three policemen who beat up a black music producer to four to six years, in a rare case of alleged police brutality to go to criminal court. The assault on Michel Zecler, now 47, triggered renewed outrage in France over police violence, which victims and researchers say is systemic but authorities and law enforcement unions claim is limited to isolated cases. The prosecutor argued the case had caused "immense harm to Michel Zecler but also to society as a whole," and that those on trial had "betrayed" their uniform.

Each leader came to the negotiating table with their own motivations. But in a potential spoiler for Burnham's "reset", Brussels said the deals coming into force would be conditional on reaching an agreement to cut university fees for EU students in Britain. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Editor Rochelle Ferguson Bouyahi tells us more.

2bc3db1a33a4212e.summary: Spain's Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez acknowledged making "mistakes" as he faced off with his main conservative rival in a key debate on Thursday before an election next week that could leave the far right on the cusp of power. Under the deal brokered by senior Shi'ite political leaders to avert a confrontation, government ⁠forces were expected to move into the group's stronghold of Jurf al-Sakhar on Friday.

6149935e07f660ec.title: ‘A more expensive EU is not a better EU’: Austria's Minister for Europe, Claudia Bauer
6149935e07f660ec.summary: This week's programme hosted Claudia Bauer, Austria’s Federal Minister for Europe, Integration and Family while she was in Paris for the recent G7 meeting. She offered her thoughts on the diplomatic moves surrounding Ukraine, transatlantic relations, EU enlargement and a headscarf ban in Austrian schools that has caused disquiet. We also talked about the thorny negotiations involved in the EU’s next long-term budget: the Multiannual Financial Framework.

22b6435120a87ddf.title: Photography: A very French history
22b6435120a87ddf.summary: From its use as creative expression to documenting our everyday reality, photography has become an essential and widely-accessible medium since its invention. Did you know, however, that the technology was developed in France? FRANCE 24's Tanishk Saha takes a look at the French legacy of photography.

77203b320b1d2d0e.title: France investigates actor Depardieu, writer Houellebecq over alleged gang rape
77203b320b1d2d0e.summary: French police are investigating allegations actor and convicted sex offender Gérard Depardieu raped and assaulted a woman with the complicity of bestselling author Michel Houellebecq during a 2018 film shoot, two sources following the case said Friday. The plaintiff has accused the film's director Guillaume Nicloux of being complicit in the abuse.

244f421c5bd9dc11.title: 'Blade Runner 2099' & 'Rivals': The big TV shows to watch this month
244f421c5bd9dc11.summary: "Blade Runner" returns with a futuristic twist, while British bonkbuster "Rivals" is back with part two of season two. TV critic Dheepthika Laurent joins Eve Jackson to review the month’s big releases, including Netflix’s acclaimed Arctic comedy "North of North" and the lavish K-drama "Remarried Empress".

9b0078fc50183223.title: Gen Z protests spread across Europe: Mass rallies over cost of living in Spain
9b0078fc50183223.summary: Protesters across Europe are set took to the streets on Friday in a show of cross-border solidarity, joining coordinated demonstrations against the rising cost of living, militarisation and other causes, in a bid to increase pressure on their governments. Protesters across Europe are set to take to the streets on Friday in a show of cross-border solidarity, joining coordinated demonstrations against the rising cost of living, militarisation and other causes, in a bid to increase pressure on their governments. FRANCE 24's Sarah Morris reports from Madrid, Spain.

4ed4e4415ece0a4a.title: French ex-PM Villepin announces presidential run
4ed4e4415ece0a4a.summary: France's former prime minister and foreign minister Dominique de Villepin, famed abroad for his excoriating 2003 denunciation of US plans for invading Iraq, said on Friday he was running for president. Villepin enters an already crowded field of candidates seeking to succeed President Emmanuel Macron, with polls pointing towards a possible run-off between frontrunner Marine Le Pen of the far-right National Rally (RN) and hard-left France Unbowed (LFI) veteran Jean-Luc Melenchon.

4d9e0ca546e1cde8.title: Shenzhen trilateral: Xi Jinping's 'masterclass in diplomatic theatre'
4d9e0ca546e1cde8.summary: Xi Jinping positioned himself as a great statesman when he met with the US president and Russia's Vladimir Putin for trilateral talks in Shenzhen this week. But while the Chinese president sparkled on the world stage, does he have anything to show for it? Seong-Hyon Lee, an associate at Harvard University Asia Center, tells us how the trilateral has come up short on deliverables.

9f231adcaccfb377.title: Spain’s political crossroads, Europe’s wider stakes: Spaniards to vote in key election
9f231adcaccfb377.summary: The stakes are high – not only for people in Spain, but also for Europe. On November 29, the country holds a parliamentary election that could see the end of the Socialist-led government and potentially a coalition between the right and the far right, in one of the EU’s biggest and most influential member states. It could also signal the end of Pedro Sanchez’s third term in office. Among other things, the prime minister may pay the political price for two shocking train crashes and the migrant crisis in Spain’s North African exclave of Ceuta.

a7bf0a99ba27bbdb.title: Jamaica's beaches are increasingly off limits to locals
a7bf0a99ba27bbdb.summary: Jamaica usually conjures up images of white sandy beaches, Rastafari culture and Bob Marley – but another reality exists. On this small Caribbean island, less than 1 percent of the coastline is freely accessible to local people. The rest has gradually been privatised, mostly for large hotel developments and private homes.

d10cc5570c242904.title: Cincinnati Zoo's famed Fiona the hippo dies days after eating a visitor’s hat
d10cc5570c242904.summary: Fiona, the hippo whose premature birth and fight for survival at the Cincinnati Zoo turned her into a global sensation nearly a decade ago, died Thursday from complications after swallowing a knit hat that was accidentally flung into her enclosure. She was 9 years old. “It is with extreme sadness that we share with you the devastating news that Fiona did not make it after multiple attempts from our amazing vets and keeper team to help her through what ended up being a medical emergency,” the zoo said in a statement.

d3cc19b5c29c8f10.title: Sans Starlink, l'Ukraine à l'assaut du pont de Crimée avec des drones relais
d3cc19b5c29c8f10.summary: Les frappes ukrainiennes contre le pont de Crimée depuis le 15 novembre ont été saluées comme un succès opérationnel majeur par l'Ukraine. Elles ont été facilitées par ce que le Financial Times a appelé des "modems volants", c'est-à-dire des drones relais de communication permettant de palier les limites de Starlink. Une technique méconnue mais de plus en plus en vogue sur le front ukrainien.

e808afdd00f10f25.title: Camille Lellouche, 360 degrés de talents
e808afdd00f10f25.summary: Rendez-vous avec l'artiste pluridisciplinaire Camille Lellouche à l'occasion de la sortie de son nouvel album "Minuit". Autrice, compositrice, musicienne, chanteuse, humoriste et comédienne, elle revient sur son enfance à Vitry-sur-Seine, en banlieue parisienne, ses influences musicales – de la Mafia K'1 Fry aux valses de Chopin –, mais aussi sur la pugnacité et l'endurance nécessaires pour imposer sa liberté créative.

ed51ec29dacdb140.title: États-Unis : l'hippopotame star du zoo de Cincinnati est morte
ed51ec29dacdb140.summary: Fiona, l’hippopotame star du zoo de Cincinnati dans l’Ohio (États-Unis), est morte le 19 novembre après avoir mangé un bonnet accidentellement tombé dans son enclos. La femelle âgé de 9 ans n’a pas survécu malgré les soins prodigués par les équipes vétérinaires.

58a98e287e4d7c9b.title: Boom de l'intelligence artificielle : la révolution à quel prix ?
58a98e287e4d7c9b.summary: L'entrée en Bourse spectaculaire d'Anthropic n'aura pas suffi à dissiper les inquiétudes des marchés financiers. Rentabilité incertaine, turbulences chez Nvidia, contestation des centres de données... derrière les promesses de l'intelligence artificielle, les premières limites apparaissent.

780a042e89f4f827.title: 🔴 Rencontre Trump, Poutine et Xi : suivez la conférence de presse du président américain

6fa30be7d1774cc7.title: Mobilisations : la jeunesse européenne en colère
6fa30be7d1774cc7.summary: À travers l'Europe, des jeunes d'une vingtaine de pays s'apprêtent à descendre dans la rue vendredi 20 novembre et ce week-end pour une grève internationale sous le mot d'ordre "Battez-vous pour notre avenir, pas pour leurs guerres".

20e485929b1d0737.title: Fuites au ministère de l'Intérieur : comment le RN a progressivement séduit les hauts fonctionnaires
20e485929b1d0737.summary: Le parquet de Paris soupçonne l'ancien secrétaire général de Beauvau et actuel préfet du Loiret et de la région Centre-Val de Loire, Hugues Moutouh, d'avoir informé le Rassemblement national sur des enquêtes judiciaires visant le parti. Une affaire qui illustre l'influence grandissante du parti lepéniste dans les hautes sphères de l'État.

c22c41af9a0ca014.title: Salvador : Nayib Bukele, autoproclamé “dictateur le plus cool du monde”, brigue un troisième mandat.
c22c41af9a0ca014.summary: Le président de droite du Salvador, Nayib Bukele, a déposé jeudi 19 novembre au soir sa candidature pour un troisième mandat. Le Salvador, ayant modifié sa Constitution l'an dernier pour abolir la limite du nombre de mandats présidentiels, permet au candidat de se représenter à nouveau.

8ad31c5b30bef176.title: Hubert Védrine : "Ce sommet Poutine-Xi-Trump est humiliant pour l'UE, mais sans décision concrète"
8ad31c5b30bef176.summary: Cette semaine, Caroline De Camaret reçoit Hubert Védrine, ancien secrétaire général de l'Élysée sous la présidence de François Mitterrand et ancien ministre socialiste des Affaires étrangères du gouvernement de Lionel Jospin. À l'occasion de la sortie de son ouvrage "2027, le rendez-vous du courage ?" (éditions Plon), il revient sur l'impuissance de l'Europe sur la scène internationale, sur la question migratoire et sur le sens à donner à la construction européenne depuis sa perspective gaullo-mitterrandiste.

094684dcf093e959.title: Législatives anticipées en Espagne : Pedro Sánchez en danger ?
094684dcf093e959.summary: Le 29 novembre, les regards du Parlement européen se tourneront du côté de l'Espagne, où sont organisées des élections législatives anticipées. Au pouvoir depuis 2018, le Premier ministre socialiste espagnol Pedro Sánchez a décidé, le mois dernier, de dissoudre le Parlement après le rejet de son projet de loi pour favoriser l'accès au logement.

eac836ae9c1cfda0.title: Colombie : manifestations contre une réforme fiscale voulue par le gouvernement
eac836ae9c1cfda0.summary: Des milliers de personnes ont manifesté jeudi dans plusieurs villes de Colombie contre une réforme fiscale ciblant la classe moyenne, impulsée par le gouvernement de droite dure d'Abelardo de la Espriella.

b7bdc0302a0f1051.title: La COP31 entre en prolongations pour tenter d'arracher un accord sur le climat
b7bdc0302a0f1051.summary: La COP sur le climat en Turquie, qui devait officiellement s'achever à 18 heure (15 heures GMT) vendredi, se poursuit alors que près de 200 pays tentent d'arracher un accord, mais s'écharpent encore sur plusieurs sujets comme les énergies fossiles et la finance. Une nouvelle proposition de compromis est attendue dans la soirée.

5ef77fa4b970ca42.title: Ukraine : au moins neuf morts après une attaque massive de drones et de missiles russes
5ef77fa4b970ca42.summary: La Russie a lancé une vaste offensive aérienne contre l’Ukraine dans la nuit du jeudi 19 au vendredi 20 novembre. Le bilan fait état d’au moins neuf morts. Plusieurs infrastructures énergétiques et de transport ont également été touchées.

aee656e66d48743a.title: Fiona, l'hippo star d'un zoo américain, meurt après avoir avalé un bonnet
aee656e66d48743a.summary: Fiona, un hippopotame du zoo américain de Cincinnati (nord) devenue star des réseaux sociaux, est morte jeudi, une dizaine de jours après avoir malencontreusement englouti un bonnet, a annoncé le parc animalier.

9109d976dca19721.title: مؤشر "ناسداك" ينخفض بعد تراجع حاد لأسهم شركة الذكاء الاصطناعي "أنثروبيك"
9109d976dca19721.summary: انخفض المؤشر "ناسداك" الجمعة بأكثر من واحد بالمئة عند الفتح، مع تراجع حاد لأسهم شركة الذكاء الاصطناعي "أنثروبيك" بعد ‌طرحها الأولي الذي حقق نجاحا باهرا، ما فاقم الضغوط على هذا القطاع الذي يعاني أصلا من مخاوف بشأن ‌التقييمات.

4f850d0000e5bdc7.title: تونس: الحكم بسجن الناشطة الحقوقية البارزة سهام بن سدرين خمس سنوات
4f850d0000e5bdc7.summary: حكم القضاء التونسي بالسجن خمس سنوات على الناشطة الحقوقية سهام بن سدرين في تهم تخص الفساد الإداري خلال فترة رئاستها لهيئة العدالة الانتقالية "الحقيقة والكرامة"، بحسب ما قال محاميها الجمعة. تعقيبا، أدانت منظمة "محامون بلا حدود" الحكم واعتبرت أن القضاء يُستغل في "استهداف الهيئة المكلّفة كشف مرتكبي الانتهاكات الجسيمة لحقوق الإنسان".

6e1cf35ec9700e6b.title: مباشر: مؤتمر صحفي للرئيس الأمريكي دونالد ترامب غداة القمة الثلاثية مع شي وبوتين

6fdf12c3c28a3ebe.title: فرنسا: حزب التجمع الوطني اليميني المتطرف في قلب فضيحة تسريبات قضائية جديدة
6fdf12c3c28a3ebe.summary: يشتبه القضاء في تسريب معلومات تتعلق بتحقيقات جارية في فرنسا.وقامت الشرطة بعمليات تفتيش بمقر حزب التجمع الوطني وداخل وزراة الداخلية .كما يُشتبه في تورّط مسؤول رفيع كان يعمل في وزراة الداخلية. مع الأستاذ طارق أبو الجمال.

7475281c68a24825.title: قمة ترامب وشي وبوتين: وسط غياب أوروبي...لقاء "استعراضي" أكثر منه خطوة لوضع "نظام دولي جديد"
7475281c68a24825.summary: عقدت قمة ثلاثية غير مسبوقة الخميس جمعت الرئيس الصيني شي جينبينغ بنظيريه الأمريكي دونالد ترامب والروسي فلاديمير بوتين على هامش القمة السنوية لمنتدى التعاون الاقتصادي لدول آسيا والمحيط الهادئ (أبيك). ووصف هذا اللقاء بالتاريخي لما يحمله من طابع غير مسبوق، فيما غابت عنه قوى إقليمية أخرى وخاصة أوروبا. فما مخرجات هذه القمة وهل طغت رمزيتها على نتائج ملموسة وسط غياب أوروبي ملحوظ؟

00708a06bfe15bd0.title: نجيب بوكيلي.. الرئيس الذي غيّر وجه السلفادور وأثار الجدل
00708a06bfe15bd0.summary: قدم رئيس السلفادور نجيب بوكيلي ترشحه لولاية ثالثة ، بعدما أقر البرلمان تعديلا دستوريا يتيح إعادة انتخاب الرئيس من دون حد أقصى.

4aa0e44f562aebf7.title: موجة مظاهرات تجتاح دولا أوروبية بدءا من الجمعة ضد "عسكرة" المجتمع وغلاء المعيشة
4aa0e44f562aebf7.summary: في ظل تزايد الغضب الاجتماعي مؤخرا في عدة دول أوروبية، بدأت الجمعة موجة مظاهرات منسقة لثلاثة أيام من اليونان إلى فرنسا مرورا بألمانيا وإيطاليا وبلجيكا، بدعوة من النقابات والجمعيات والمنظمات الشبابية، رافعة بشكل خاص مطالب تخص الخدمات العامة والحق في السكن وقضايا المناخ، وأيضا للتنديد بالغلاء و"عسكرة" المجتمع.

ff58be76cb6c73a5.title: السلفادور: نجيب بوكيلة يسعى لولاية رئاسية ثالثة
ff58be76cb6c73a5.summary: أعلن رئيس السلفادور، البالغ من العمر 45 عاماً، رسمياً عن ترشحه للانتخابات المقررة في فبراير 2027. وقد تمكن بوكيلي -الذي يصف نفسه بـ"أروع دكتاتور على وجه الأرض"- من تحقيق ذلك بفضل تعديل دستوري أُقرّ العام الماضي. دخل بوكيل,، وهو رجل أعمال سابق، معترك السياسة من خلال حزب "جبهة فارابوندو مارتي للتحرير الوطني" اليساري، قبل أن يتولى منصب عمدة العاصمة سان سلفادور في عام 2015. ثم انتُخب رئيساً للبلاد في عام 2019، وأعيد انتخابه في عام 2024. ويتمتع بوكيلة اليوم بنسبة تأييد لافتة تقارب 80%، يُعزى الفضل الأكبر فيها إلى حربه ضد العصابات، والتي أدت إلى انخفاض حاد في معدلات الجريمة في البلاد.

46ce679c574633dc.title: الرقائق الإلكترونية وإمدادات النفط على طاولة ترامب وبوتين وشي.. تفاهم ثلاثي لإعادة رسم مناطق النفوذ؟
46ce679c574633dc.summary: نناقش في برنامج "الأسبوع الاقتصادي" أبرز الملفات تم مناقشتها خلال القمة الثلاثية التي جمعت الرئيس شي جينبيغ مع ترامب وبوتين على هامش منتدى التعاون الاقتصادي لدول آسيا والمحيط الهادئ "أبيك"، وما قد تفتح له من آفاق لتوسيع إمدادات النفط وتخفيف القيود على صادرات الرقائق الإلكترونية، إلى جانب مستقبل الهدنة التجارية وسلاسل التوريد والمعادن النادرة. ونتطرق للتحذيرات التي أعلنت عنها المفوضية الأوروبية بشأن تخطي العجز المالي الفرنسي 5.5% خلال العام الحالي، ونختتم بملف العقوبات التي فرضتها المملكة المتحدة على 8 شركات متهمة ببناء مستوطنات في الضفة الغربية المحتلة.

66b5affbf55d8c60.title: محكمة العدل الدولية تدين بورما بارتكاب إبادة جماعية بحق الروهينغا
66b5affbf55d8c60.summary: في قرار تاريخي هو الأول من نوعه للمحكمة ضد دولة أعلنت محكمة العدل الدولية أن بورما ارتكبت إبادة جماعية بحق أقليات الروهينغا المسلمة.

15d74a5cc6b9e54b.title: لماذا تُحرم المرأة السورية من حق منح جنسيتها لأبنائها؟
15d74a5cc6b9e54b.summary: عاد ملف حقوق المرأة السورية إلى صدارة النقاش، بعدما أعلنت وزيرة الشؤون الاجتماعية والعمل السورية هند قبوات، خلال جلسة للأمم المتحدة في جنيف في 4 تشرين الثاني/نوفمبر 2026، أن مقترح منح الجنسية السورية لأبناء السوريات المتزوجات من غير سوريين وصل إلى "مرحلة الإقرار". غير أن المقترح لم يصل بعد إلى مجلس الشعب، بحسب النائبة نور عربو، ولا يزال قيد الدراسة والإعداد، فيما شكلت لجنة حكومية برئاسة وزارة الداخلية لدراسته. وبحسب ما أعلنته الوزيرة، يشترط المقترح أن تكون الأم سورية بالأصل لا بالتجنيس.

db6a076f12c97708.title: روسيا تنتقم لقصف جسر القرم.. أكبر هجوم على أوكرانيا منذ بدء الحرب
db6a076f12c97708.summary: رداً على الضربات الأوكرانية المتكررة التي استهدفت جسر القرم، صعّدت موسكو هجماتها على العمق الأوكراني منفذة واحدة من أعنف موجات القصف منذ اندلاع الحرب. صواريخ وطائرات مسيّرة أمطرت كييف ومدنا عدة، مستهدفة الجسور والبنى التحتية للطاقة والنقل والموانئ، فيما أمضى آلاف الأوكرانيين ليلتهم في محطات المترو والملاجئ هرباً من القصف الذي توعد الرئيس الروسي فلاديمير بوتين بأن يكون "أشد إيلاماً".

e2a5e558f2e499f3.title: شبهة تسريب معلومات قضائية تهز وزارة الداخلية الفرنسية وحزب التجمع الوطني
e2a5e558f2e499f3.summary: القضاء يشتبه في تسريب معلومات تتعلق بتحقيقات جاريةقامت الشرطة بعمليات تفتيش بمقر حزب التجمع الوطني وداخل وزراة الداخلية .كما يُشتبه في تورّط مسؤول رفيع كان يعمل في وزراة الداخلية.

6fcba50a80842672.title: فرنسا: الجرائم الجنسية ضد الأطفال.. ملاحقة الجناة
6fcba50a80842672.summary: صوت نواب البرلمان الفرنسي على مشروع قانون شامل لمناهضة العنف القائم على النوع الاجتماعي والعنف الجنسي ضد النساء والأطفال. القانون يهدف إلى توفير حماية ومواكبة أفضل للضحايا، بدءا من مرحلة الرصد والكشف ووصولا إلى الاستجابة القضائية. نستعرض في برنامج "هنا فرنسا" الجانب الوقائي المتعلق بمرتكبي الجرائم الجنسية ضد الأطفال، علما أن مشروع القانون لا يتضمن أي تدابير بهذا الشأن. فهل سيكون القانون كافياً إذن لمكافحة هذه الجرائم بفعالية؟

4c1766a6097a9ad3.title: Britain and Brussels Have Begun a Brexit Rollback. How Far Will It Go?
4c1766a6097a9ad3.summary: The United Kingdom is removing barriers with the European Union a decade after it voted to leave. Global turmoil, and the disruptive policies of President Trump, helped push them back together.

0045ca931e1599fd.title: Iraqi Forces Enter Stronghold of Powerful Iran-Backed Militia
0045ca931e1599fd.summary: For the first time in over a decade, army and police units were deployed in territory controlled by the group, Kataib Hezbollah. But it was unclear if it would withdraw its forces.

745e2580eb536fe1.title: ‘Russian Objects’ Crashed in Poland, Officials Say. Here’s What We Can See.
745e2580eb536fe1.summary: There were no injuries or damage from three incidents that the Polish authorities called a likely “provocation” from Russia during military exercises by Ukraine’s allies.

026966760f99b2a5.title: Chinese-Born Neuroscientist Is Detained by ICE While Traveling From Conference
026966760f99b2a5.summary: Eva Yi Xie was detained on her way back to New Jersey from a neuroscience conference in Washington this week, the latest in a string of researcher arrests.

d34060bde6fefc06.title: Devilish or Delightful? Krampus Is Banned From a Christmas Parade.
d34060bde6fefc06.summary: After an appearance last year, a float depicting Krampus, St. Nicholas’s evil accomplice, will not be allowed in an Ontario town’s Santa Claus parade on Saturday.

cc1de58b692260bb.title: Many Etsy Sellers Close Up Shop Over Site’s New A.I. Policy
cc1de58b692260bb.summary: Numerous longtime users of the online marketplace have left the platform because they do not want their work training artificial intelligence. Etsy defended its policy.

ad81317a340af6e1.title: Nissan Shuts Down System Used for Repairs After Hack Attempt
